Who We Are

AppSecure is a global leader in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, and Pentest as a Service (PtaaS). We bring together the top 10 hackers from renowned bug bounty programs including PayPal, Reddit, LinkedIn, WooCommerce, and Amazon.

Our expertise lies in identifying real and exploitable security vulnerabilities within your systems—vulnerabilities that, if left unchecked, could lead to substantial business loss if malicious black-hat hackers manage to exploit them from outside.

What Sets Us Apart
Why Should You Choose Appsecure?
Top Bug Bounty Talent

AppSecure was founded by ethical hackers who ranked among the top 10 bug bounty hunters for Fortune 500 companies like PayPal, Reddit, LinkedIn, and Instacart.

Comprehensive Services

From application and network security to red teaming, threat simulations, and beyond, we offer a comprehensive, multi-layered approach to protecting your organization from every angle.

Customer-Centric Approach

We work closely with your team to develop and implement actionable security measures that strengthen your defenses and ensure long-term protection.

Proactive Solutions

Our techniques continuously adapt to the evolving threat landscape, ensuring that your defenses stay ahead of emerging risks and remain robust against future challenges.

Our Mission

At AppSecure Security, our mission is to make the digital world safer, one client at a time. We do this by offering exceptional end-to-end offensive security services with a strong focus on the customer

Our Goals
Proactive Security

We strive to anticipate and mitigate security risks before they become threats. Our team of highly experienced professionals, including cybersecurity researchers and technology experts, uses real-world hacking techniques to understand our customers' security posture.

Empowering Organizations

We are committed to empowering organizations to protect their customers' data and privacy. By identifying and addressing potential weaknesses and vulnerabilities within web applications' security infrastructure, we help our clients stay one step ahead of potential threats.

Setting the Gold Standard

Our goal is to set the gold standard in offensive security through innovation and expertise. By leveraging real-world insights and a proactive research approach, we deliver tailored solutions that strengthen our clients' defenses and keep them ahead in a dynamic security landscape.

Ensuring Compliance

We aim to ensure compliance with industry standards like SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001. Our comprehensive approach to offensive security research involves actively examining our clients' application security assets for potential threats, misconfigurations, and backdoors that hackers could exploit.
